title: ASCII DXF control-string semantics and 3D comparator boundaries
mode: Primary-source research and local source audit; plan refinement only
worktreeState: Dirty shared worktree; existing changes preserved
scope: Resolve ASCII DXF control-character string behavior against Autodesk's published rule.
Compare the semantic string writer/parser paths with raw-carrier and Binary-DXF paths.
Refresh open-source reader and consumer boundaries relevant to DXF syntax and ACIS/ACDS semantics.
Add an implementation-ready local finding without expanding routine or full-suite validation.

sources.observed: ASCII control characters in text strings are written as caret plus the corresponding character; a literal caret is written as caret-space; OPEN and INSERT perform the complementary conversion.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Normative ASCII-string contract. The page does not spell out every code-point edge or field-specific CR/LF policy.

sources.revision: Open issue reports reviewed 2026-10-19; exact issue builds and customer files are not bound to current release artifacts
sources.observed: #1412 reports allocator-dependent uninitialized-tail output after control-character quoting; #1408 reports raw-CR ASCII framing corruption; #1411 reports R2013+ AcDs/ACDSDATA omission and lost SAB geometry while solid entity shells remain.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Peer-specific reports and test leads only; they do not demonstrate the same defect in libdxfrw or provide independent solid semantics.

sources.observed: DWG is handled through external converter-to-DXF processing; the stock DXF importer documentation says ACIS solids cannot currently be read.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Consumer route documentation; no native FreeCAD run or 3D/B-rep acceptance was performed.

sources.revision: Mutable master README and repository release list reviewed 2026-10-19
sources.observed: The README lists most 2D entities, layers, blocks/inserts, some MTEXT/XDATA, and explicitly excludes 3DSolids and some leaders/objects; no release artifact is listed on the repository page.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Self-declared narrow DXF route; no runtime or exact package/source match was tested.

sources.observed: Strict read and recovery-plus-audit are distinct; recovery may repair structural flaws and may retain decode errors that can cause data loss on save.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Documentation only; strict/recovery commands were not run in this pass.

sources.observed: The current typed text checks reject NUL/CR/LF but do not caret-map other control scalars; the ASCII sink writes accepted bytes directly; the converter handles CIF/MIF but has no caret-pair inverse. Existing focused tests cover physical framing/newline paths, not BEL/ESC/DEL or literal caret semantics.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Source-confirmed uncovered route, not an executed regression or independent acceptance result.

method.kind: Read-only web review plus local source and test-coverage inspection
method.limitations: The local finding is based on source-path comparison with Autodesk's documented behavior; it was not executed. LibreDWG issues are route-specific reports. Optional native, independent-parser, and kernel qualification remain separate and non-blocking for implementation.

assessment.planImpact: Adds PAR-136 under existing PAR-05/7AR with a generated ASCII semantic-string escape/decode sequence; retains raw replay and Binary-DXF boundaries, current NUL/newline policy, the reduced validation cadence, and the separate ACIS/ACDS semantic gate.

implementationReadyChecks: Encode and decode semantic ASCII text strings using the documented caret notation exactly once; preserve literal caret through caret-space.
Keep raw DXF groups, opaque application bytes, Binary DXF, and C1-byte policy outside this transformation unless separately specified.
Keep NUL refused and preserve the existing TEXT CR/LF refusal and MTEXT paragraph-normalization behavior.
Use generated ASCII controls for BEL, ESC, caret, and explicit tab/DEL boundary cases; assert exact raw spelling, semantic readback, next-record/EOF, and atomic refusal.
Add MTEXT/ATTRIB/ATTDEF chunk-boundary controls and Binary-DXF unchanged controls as a second local slice.
Use focused targets, the existing selector and owning CTest; no full suite or persistent fixture is needed.
Use a pinned strict DXF parser only at the composed checkpoint; keep recovery, semantic comparison, and native acceptance separate.
